column3: This table defines allowable branch connections.  Substitutions are permitted subject to Aker Kvaerner approval.
All branch connections will be in accordance with ASME B31.3.  In the event of a conflict between B31.3 and this specification, B31.3 will govern.
This table applies to branch connections made at 90º only.
Branch will not intersect with longitudinal weld of the run.
Reinforcement "SX" in highlighted cells is for vacuum condition only.  No reinforcement is required for pressurized pipes.
